date.as_written: mārgaśīrṣe tathā kṛṣṇe jayo 'bde bhaumavāsare ... saṃvat || 1788 || || (sa me yamāc ca) vadi || 7 ||

notes: The era is not stated. VS is assumed from 'saṃvat 1788' in a Devanagari MS, giving c. 1731 CE (NS 1788 is impossible). The verse names the year 'jaya' (Jaya saṃvatsara). In the southern 60-year cycle ŚS 1653 / VS 1788 is Virodhakṛt, not Jaya, so the year name may follow another reckoning, or year or name may be wrong; this has not been checked against tables. 'mahāpuro(!)' may be a corrupt locative 'mahāpure' (place of copying, unidentified) or simply 'mahāpuraḥ'. '(sa me yamāc ca)' before 'vadi' is unclear; it may be a garbled restatement of the month or year. '†pāyāṃ† śalyaparva †samādā†' probably means 'śalyaparva samāptam'.
